Submit Viral Load Request.description: Sends a viral load test request for a patient sample from a health facility to the lab.

Submit Batch Of Viral Load Requests.description: Sends several samples from an EMR export to the lab in one request.

Check Viral Load Submission.description: Reads the submission response to collect saved sample ids and any errors.

Get Viral Load Results.description: Asks the lab for the results of specific samples.

Process Viral Load Results.description: Splits a results response into published results and samples still pending.

Get Sample Statuses.description: Lists the processing status of samples for a site.

List Active Sites.description: Lists the active health facility sites registered in IBIPIMO.
